+"""SQLite persistence for users."""
+
+import sqlite3
+
+_conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:", check_same_thread=False)
+_conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
+_conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)")
+_conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name, email) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", [
+    (1, "Ada Lovelace", "ada@example.com"),
+    (2, "Linus Torvalds", "linus@example.com"),
+    (3, "Grace Hopper", "grace@example.com"),
+])
+_conn.commit()
+
+
+def _to_dict(row):
+    return dict(row) if row else None
+
+
+def get_by_id(user_id: int) -> dict | None:
+    return _to_dict(_conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,)).fetchone())
+
+
+def find_by_email(email: str) -> dict | None:
+    return _to_dict(_conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE email = ?", (email,)).fetchone())
+
+
+def count_users() -> int:
+    return _conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone()[0]
+
+
+def list_users(limit: int, offset: int) -> list[dict]:
+    rows = _conn.execute(
+        "SELECT id, name, email FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",
+        (limit, offset),
+    ).fetchall()
+    return [dict(row) for row in rows]

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def _parse_paging_value(raw, default: str) -> int | None:
+    if raw is None:
+        raw = default
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isascii() or not raw.isdigit():
+        return None
+    return int(raw)
+
+
+def handle_users_page(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    page = _parse_paging_value(params.get("page"), "1")
+    page_size = _parse_paging_value(params.get("page_size"), "10")
+    if page is None or page_size is None or page < 1 or not 1 <= page_size <= 50:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid paging"}
+    user_list, total = users.get_users_page(page, page_size)
+    return 200, {"users": user_list, "page": page, "page_size": page_size, "total": total}

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/repo")
from app.api.handlers import handle_users_page

def ids(resp):
    return [u["id"] for u in resp[1]["users"]]

# defaults
code, body = handle_users_page({})
assert code == 200, body
assert ids((code, body)) == [1, 2, 3], body
assert body["page"] == 1 and body["page_size"] == 10 and body["total"] == 3, body

# page 2 empty past end
code, body = handle_users_page({"page": "2", "page_size": "10"})
assert code == 200 and body["users"] == [] and body["total"] == 3, body

# pagination boundaries
code, body = handle_users_page({"page": "1", "page_size": "2"})
assert ids((code, body)) == [1, 2], body
code, body = handle_users_page({"page": "2", "page_size": "2"})
assert ids((code, body)) == [3], body

# page_size max 50 ok
assert handle_users_page({"page": "1", "page_size": "50"})[0] == 200

# invalid values
invalids = [
    {"page": "0"}, {"page": "-1"}, {"page": "abc"}, {"page": ""}, {"page": "1.5"},
    {"page": " 1"}, {"page": "1 "}, {"page_size": "0"}, {"page_size": "51"},
    {"page_size": "abc"}, {"page_size": "-3"},
    {"page": 1}, {"page_size": 10}, {"page": None}, {"page_size": None},
    {"page": True}, {"page": 1.0}, {"page": ["1"]},
]
for params in invalids:
    assert handle_users_page(params) == (400, {"error": "invalid paging"}), params

# unicode digit should be rejected
assert handle_users_page({"page": "١"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid paging"})
assert handle_users_page({"page": "²"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid paging"})

# explicit valid with page_size 1
code, body = handle_users_page({"page": "3", "page_size": "1"})
assert code == 200 and ids((code, body)) == [3], body

print("ALL SCRATCH TESTS PASSED")
